description: This file defines the interface 'DoubleArray' within the Apache Commons Math library, specifying a standard set of methods for managing double array containers with features like dynamic resizing, rolling addition, and element access.

classes.name: DoubleArray
classes.description: Interface providing methods for double array implementations supporting various storage mechanisms, element manipulation, and dynamic resizing.

methods.name: getNumElements
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the array, which may differ from internal storage length.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Fetches the element at a specified index, throwing an exception if index is out of bounds.

methods.name: setElement
methods.description: Sets the element at a given index, expanding the array if necessary and allocating storage for new elements.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the array.

methods.name: addElements
methods.description: Adds multiple elements to the end of the array.

methods.name: addElementRolling
methods.description: Adds an element to the end while removing the first element, effectively implementing a rolling FIFO queue.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current elements as a double array.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the array, removing all elements.
